title: MCPSECBENCH: A SYSTEMATIC SECURITY BENCHMARK AND PLAYGROUND FOR TESTING MODEL CONTEXT PROTOCOLS
reasoning: The paper focuses exclusively on the technical security vulnerabilities of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as used by Large Language Models. It benchmarks 17 specific attack types (like prompt injection, man-in-the-middle, and sandbox escape). While it contains a standard 'Ethical Statement' regarding data usage and societal benefit, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
